docs.message:
docs: the apps can be used without any tracking; the platform counts visits only

## Intent

The vision said that only explicit clicks are counted. The platform's own pages now also count visits, so the principle must say so honestly, and that the apps can still be used entirely without tracking.

## Key changes

- The principle "No hidden data collection" now says: the apps can be used entirely without tracking; the platform's own pages count visits as totals, only to know whether anyone uses it; no cookies, no profiles.
- The same rule in the platform design (D5, D8) and in the measures (biz42 ch. 7) says the same.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Matches the usage counter of lernapps.github.io and the page rules of the tooling and .github.
